requirements.evidence: Re-audited 2026-11-26 (WP-35.S3). Shipped: configurable units, versioned effective-dated profiles with the seven work types as definition entries, employee assignments (work-profiles.e2e-spec), settings UI and portable workProfile/workUnit components (WP-35.S2), and work items with a stored profile version id (work-items.e2e-spec).
